property.name: Casa Alon Transient House
property.tagline: Sea-breeze rooms a short walk from the beach
property.location: Brgy. Poblacion, San Juan, La Union
property.house_rules: No smoking indoors. Quiet hours 10PM–7AM. No pets. Extra guest beyond capacity not allowed.
property.about:
Casa Alon is a family-run transient house in the heart of San Juan, La Union — the surf capital of the north. We started with two rooms in our ancestral home and grew into a cozy stay for barkadas, couples and families who want to wake up to the sound of the waves.

We keep things simple: clean rooms, fast WiFi, a shared kitchen, and hosts who actually live here and know the best spots for sunset, sinigang and surf.
highlights: Fast fiber WiFi in every room

services.title: Surf lessons
services.description: 1.5-hour beginner lesson with a local instructor and board rental.

services.title: Filipino breakfast
services.description: Tapsilog, longsilog or pancakes served on the veranda, 7–10AM.

services.title: Island & falls tours
services.description: Day trips to Tangadan Falls and the grape farms of Bauang.

services.title: Celebration setups
services.description: Birthday or anniversary room decor with cake and flowers.

faqs.q: How do I book a room?
faqs.a: Send a stay request using the form on this page. The owner checks availability and messages you with downpayment instructions. Your dates are secured once the downpayment is received.
Yes — free parking for up to 3 cars, first come first served.

faqs.q: Can I cancel or change my dates?
faqs.a: Message us at least 7 days before check-in to move your dates. Downpayments are non-refundable but can be used for a rebooking within 3 months.

faqs.q: Do you allow early check-in or late check-out?
faqs.a: Subject to availability. Ask us on the day and we'll do our best — a small fee may apply.
